text: 香港证监会行政总裁梁凤仪周三在一场记者会上表示，香港交易所将与市场参与者讨论延长交易时间的可能性。（彭博）
text_en: Julia Leung, Chief Executive Officer of the Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission, said at a press conference on Wednesday that Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing will discuss with market participants the possibility of extending trading hours. (Bloomberg)
